title: Attention Is All We Need
concept: A love song to the Transformer, told as a dating history drawn as architecture diagrams. The singer's first love was the RNN, who faded with every word (the vanishing gradient); the rebound was the LSTM, all fancy gates and still stuck in sequential time; then self-attention looked at every word at once. Vertical, for Shorts, and every frame is drawn in code from the real vocal timing.
thesis: Attention is all we need, now I realize.

rules.name: Every ex is an architecture
rules.text: The RNN, the LSTM and the Transformer are drawn the way they really work: a chain, a column of gated cells, and a ring of tokens that all attend to each other.

rules.name: The words are the tokens
rules.text: Each sung word lands in a cell, a gate or an attention node exactly when it is sung, so the diagram is the lyric.

rules.name: The loss falls with the story
rules.text: A JSON readout at the top tracks the model, the training step, the current token and a loss that falls from about four to near zero by the last line.

rules.name: No generated footage
rules.text: Nothing here came from an image or video model. It is all Canvas2D, rendered frame by frame in headless Chrome.

cast.name: The RNN
cast.text: First love. Recurrent, one word at a time, and the feeling fades with every hop.

cast.name: The LSTM
cast.text: The rebound. Input, forget and output gates, long short-term memory, still sequential.

cast.name: The Transformer
cast.text: Self-attention, multi-head, positional encoding and residual streams. The one.

layers.CODE: Drawn in code (Canvas2D) from the real word timing.

timingNote: Word timings from Whisper aligned to the lyrics, on a 120 BPM beat grid. Each scene runs for the lyric lines that share one diagram.

scenes.title: First love: the RNN
scenes.lyric: You were my first love, RNN, recurrent neural network / You promised me everything but you left me hanging / On vanishing gradients, one word at a time / Drowning in your hesitance
scenes.shot: RNN. A chain of hidden-state cells zig-zags down the screen, one sung word per cell. A pink heart is handed down the chain and shrinks at every hop while the gradient readout falls (0.72 to the power of the step): the vanishing gradient as a love that fades. On "drowning" the cells sink.

scenes.title: The LSTM with the fancy gates
scenes.lyric: Then came LSTM with your fancy gates / Long, short-term memory, you said we'd relate
scenes.shot: LSTM. The words fill a column of memory cells, each with input, forget and output gate bars that slam open and shut on the beat. Cells not yet sung sit "waiting...".

scenes.title: Stuck in sequential time
scenes.lyric: But you were still stuck in sequential time
scenes.shot: A clock that will not advance: the hands tick one step per word, a single token at a time, while a training progress bar crawls.

scenes.title: Training took forever
scenes.lyric: Training took forever, you were never really mine
scenes.shot: An epoch counter climbs and climbs; the loss barely moves. "never really mine" breaks the heart in two.

scenes.title: Then you showed me how to parallelize
scenes.lyric: Then you showed me how to parallelize / With self-attention in your transformer eyes
scenes.shot: The sequential chain snaps apart and every word lights at once, side by side, in parallel lanes.

scenes.title: No more waiting
scenes.lyric: No more waiting, no more lies / Attention is all we need, now I realize
scenes.shot: The line lays out as a ring of tokens. Every word draws attention arcs to every other word at once, arc brightness from an attention matrix, while the matrix fills in as a heatmap below.

scenes.title: Forward pass (instrumental)
scenes.shot: The break: "the love of my life is a transformer" as a ring of tokens wired all-to-all, the arcs pulsing, the layer counter cycling through twelve layers.

scenes.title: The LSTM with the fancy gates
scenes.lyric: My rebound, LSTM / With your input, output, and forget gates / Seemed you'd handle long texts better, or so you claimed (?)
scenes.shot: LSTM. The words fill a column of memory cells, each with input, forget and output gate bars that slam open and shut on the beat. Cells not yet sung sit "waiting...".

scenes.title: Stuck in sequential time
scenes.lyric: But you still process slow, I was still chained
scenes.shot: A clock that will not advance: the hands tick one step per word, a single token at a time, while a training progress bar crawls.

scenes.title: Backprop, endless night
scenes.lyric: I was stuck in backprop, endless night / Waiting for gradients to propagate right
scenes.shot: A night sky over a stack of twelve layers. A red heart (the gradient) travels back down the stack and shrinks by a power of ten at each layer.

scenes.title: Multi-head attention
scenes.lyric: Then your multi-head attention held me tight / And showed me all words can shine in the same light
scenes.shot: The attention ring again, now with eight heads, eight coloured dots all looking at once; on "the same light" every head weights every word equally.

scenes.title: No recurrence
scenes.lyric: No more sequences, no more delay
scenes.shot: The line lays out as a ring of tokens. Every word draws attention arcs to every other word at once, arc brightness from an attention matrix, while the matrix fills in as a heatmap below.

scenes.title: Context doesn't fade
scenes.shot: The line lays out as a ring of tokens. Every word draws attention arcs to every other word at once, arc brightness from an attention matrix, while the matrix fills in as a heatmap below.

scenes.title: Query meets key
scenes.lyric: Query meets key in perfect array
scenes.shot: The line lays out as a ring of tokens. Every word draws attention arcs to every other word at once, arc brightness from an attention matrix, while the matrix fills in as a heatmap below.

scenes.title: Attention is all we need
scenes.lyric: Attention is all we need, now I can say
scenes.shot: The line lays out as a ring of tokens. Every word draws attention arcs to every other word at once, arc brightness from an attention matrix, while the matrix fills in as a heatmap below.

scenes.title: Positional encoding, residual streams
scenes.shot: A scrolling sine and cosine grid (positional encoding) above residual-stream bars that loop around each block.

scenes.title: Rebuilt
scenes.lyric: You rebuilt my broken machine learning dreams
scenes.shot: Transformer blocks (multi-head attention, add and norm, feed forward) fall into place on the beat, one per beat, building the machine back up.

scenes.title: No more RNNs or LSTMs
scenes.shot: RNN and LSTM in big letters, struck through in red; "attention" glows in neon underneath.

scenes.title: Transformer hymns
scenes.lyric: Just attention forever in transformer hymns
scenes.shot: The last line: the attention matrix becomes a stained-glass window, lit from behind, with "transformer hymns" in gold serif. Fade to black.

decisions: The verse 2 line about handling long texts is still a best guess at the sung words.
The old still-image Short of this song stays up for now.

page.description: The Attention Is All We Need music video: a love song to the Transformer, told as a dating history drawn as architecture diagrams (RNN, LSTM, self-attention). Every frame drawn in code. Scene book and timeline included.

howMade.label: Timing
howMade.text: The vocal is transcribed with Whisper and aligned word by word to the lyrics, on a 120 BPM beat grid.

howMade.label: Diagrams
howMade.text: Each scene is a real architecture drawn in Canvas2D: the RNN chain and its vanishing gradient, LSTM gates, attention rings and heatmaps, backprop through twelve layers, positional encoding.

howMade.label: Render
howMade.text: Headless Chrome renders every frame at 1080 by 1920, then ffmpeg adds the song. No generated clips, no stills.

page.sourceNote: Built outside Remotion, in the private music-videos repo (attention-video: engine, timing and render).
